description: Estimate monthly X Premium Creator Ads Revenue Share payout from impressions. X pays creators based on ads shown in REPLIES to their posts, not the posts themselves — so reply density is the lever. Requires X Premium + 500 verified followers + 25M impressions over the trailing 3 months for eligibility.

avgRepliesPerPost.description: Average replies per post (drives ad inventory in replies — default 20)

cpmEstimate.description: Estimated CPM in USD for reply ads (industry estimate $1.50-$4 — default $2.50)

monthlyImpressions.description: Total impressions on your posts in the past 30 days

name: calculate_x_ads_revenue
